_comment: Lebanon source pack. One entry per public source; pack.py reads it. sectors: who the source is for ('*' = every Lebanese company; see pack.SECTOR_RULES). access: how LeadFinder may read it (automated = public pages / files, polite and robots-aware; manual_file = only a file an operator supplies; disabled = not read at all). quality: how much a role it states is trusted (0-100). refresh_days: when its documents are checked again (an unchanged document is never parsed again).

sources.name: Association of Banks in Lebanon - Almanac of Banks
sources.notes: Public PDF (183 pages): per member bank, board of directors, senior management, founder, branch managers, official bank number, commercial registry number, website.

sources.name: Association of Banks in Lebanon - Heads of HR
sources.notes: The public 'Heads of HR' listing (abl.org.lb/english/abl-members-and-guide/heads-of-hr), read through the same JSON its 'Load More' button calls.

sources.name: Insurance Control Commission - register of companies
sources.notes: Official register: insurers and brokers with General Manager, Financial Manager, licence number, website; each entry dated.

sources.name: Ministry of Industry - licensed factories
sources.notes: The Industrial Guide's lists of licensed factories by sector (XLS, Arabic): factory, owner when named, website, e-mail.

sources.name: IDAL - exporters' directories
sources.notes: Agriculture / agro-food / ICT / pharmaceutical exporters (PDF, 2013-2018): a person only where a title is published; old, so never proof of a current role.

sources.name: RDCL - Lebanese Business Leaders Association
sources.notes: Board member profiles. The RDCL office (President, Treasurer...) is never a company title; a company role is kept only where the biography states it for that company.

sources.name: Association of Lebanese Industrialists - members
ali_sectors: Paper and Cartoon, and related packaging
Publishing, Printing and reproduction of recorded media
Rubber and plastic, and related packaging
sources.notes: Public member search: member company names only (identity confirmation). Member details sit behind ALI's 'request member information' form and are not read.

sources.name: Syndicate of Hospitals in Lebanon - hospital directory
sources.notes: Member hospitals: CEO, chair, founding date, beds, phone, e-mail, website, address. Undated pages: roles are 'not confirmed'.

sources.name: GLEIF - Legal Entity Identifiers (Lebanon)
sources.notes: Free GLEIF API: every active Lebanese LEI (legal name, legal form, commercial registry number, address) and its reported direct / ultimate parent. Few SMEs have an LEI.

sources.name: Public Procurement Authority - award results
sources.notes: Public award results (winner, tender, date, amount): company signals and timeline events, never people. The newest pages only (each page is ~1.7 MB); the procuring entities' portal (pe.ppa.gov.lb) requires a login and is never used.

sources.name: Berytech - startup and SME profiles
sources.notes: Lebanese innovation hub: each supported company's profile names its team (name / title). Their e-mails are personal addresses: never stored.

sources.name: Beirut One - Leaders on Stage
sources.notes: Business conference speakers: 'Name' + 'Title - Company' as published (2026 edition).

sources.name: Lebanese Franchise Association - board
sources.notes: Board members' biographies; a company role only where the biography states it for that company (the LFA office never is).

sources.name: Odoo - published Lebanese customer references
sources.notes: Vendor customer references (about 800 Lebanese companies): identity, industry and an attributed 'uses Odoo' technology signal. No people.

sources.name: Project Lebanon 2026 - exhibitors
sources.notes: Construction / interiors exhibition: Lebanese exhibitors (event participation, description). No people.

sources.name: Lebanese Contractors Syndicate - contractors' guide
sources.notes: Member contractors: company, manager, engineer, office phones, e-mail, address. The guide is undated (last edition ~2020): its people are 'not confirmed', never current.

sources.name: Executive Magazine - article index
sources.notes: Lebanon's business magazine: its own article sitemaps (URL + date) kept as a local index; an article is read only when its URL names a known company.

sources.name: The961 - article index
sources.notes: Lebanese news site: article sitemaps as a local index.

sources.name: Beirut Today - article index
sources.notes: Lebanese news site: article sitemaps as a local index.

sources.name: Banque du Liban - regulated institutions
sources.notes: bdl.gov.lb answers automated requests with HTTP 403: not read (no bypass). Banks' identity comes from the ABL almanac (official BDL list numbers).

sources.name: Lebanese Commercial Register (official extract)
sources.notes: cr.justice.gov.lb's terms (clause 4) forbid copying its information or using it commercially: it is never queried automatically. An official extract obtained by Tecomsa is ingested as a file (scripts/lebanon_sources.py ingest-file).

sources.name: Licensed business directory (e.g. 5INDEX, when licensed)
sources.notes: Subscription directories are never scraped (5index.com is blocked). Licensed exports (5INDEX, Yelleb, Infobel, Kompass, IFP) are imported through the app (Settings > Directory imports) or contributions.py LICENSED_DIRECTORY, not this pack.
